text:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — spotted a broken internal link in the model-onboarding KB while prepping the sprint demo. 404 for /runtime/guide/old-slug, showed up on 2 slides. Anyone owning that page?
Maya R.: Thanks for flagging — which doc has the bad link? can you paste the URL?
Alex Chen: Sure — https://internal.redwood.dev/kb/models/onboarding -> links to https://internal.redwood.dev/runtime/guide/old-slug (404). Found it in /kb/sales-demo/rapid-onboard.md around line ~48.
Jonathan G: I maintain the runtime guide — it was moved during last week's restructure. @Alex can you open a tiny PR to update the link or we can add a redirect. I can review quickly. :+1:
Alex Chen: Will do. Quick sed I ran locally to patch a few files: ```bash
grep -rl "runtime/guide/old-slug" docs/ | xargs sed -i 's|runtime/guide/old-slug|runtime/guide|g'
``` I'll push a PR in a minute.
docs-bot: link-scan found 1 more occurrence in /kb/partner-onboarding.md:82
Alex Chen: Good catch — I'll include that file in the replace too.
Sam K: If we prefer redirects (to preserve old external bookmarks), infra can add a small redirect rule. PR edit is fine for the demo. @Jonathan do you want a redirect as the long-term fix?
Jonathan G: Yeah, let's plan for a redirect after the PR lands. For now please accept the PR so the demo isn't blocked. :thumbsup:
Lina P: Pinged #docs-owners with a quick note — @here if you own pages referencing runtime/guide, please say so.
Maya R.: Alex, if you tag the PR with `docs:link-fix` I'll do a quick editorial pass once it's up.
Alex Chen: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/docs/+/2345 — small replace across 3 files, and I added a commit message noting the redirect ticket. CC @docs-bot :rocket:
docs-bot: CI link-check started.
docs-bot: CI link-check: passed (1 external shortlink warning). I'll create infra ticket INFR-489 for the redirect as requested.
Alex Chen: Awesome — thanks everyone, unblocking demo.
Maya R.: Nice, will skim and merge after the editorial pass.
